name: Lonesome Company
source:
The man across the diner booth insists that he's your boyfriend, but there's a bit more to your relationship than meets the eye... Is this an illusion worth breaking, though? Is there really such a thing as 'bad company' when you're already so desperate for companionship?

Maybe you'll find your answer by the end.

[From [url=https://sokkamizuki.itch.io/lonesome-company]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
餐厅摊位对面的男人坚称他是你的男朋友，但你们的关系比表面上看到的要复杂得多……不过，这是一个值得打破的幻想吗？当你已经如此渴望陪伴时，真的有“坏伙伴”这样的事情吗？

也许到最后你会找到答案。

[来自[url=https://sokkamizuki.itch.io/lonesome-company]itch.io[/url]]
